conceptualSource.title: A Rosetta Stone for AI Benchmarks
conceptualSource.authors: Ho, Denain, Atanasov, Albanie, and Shah

paperOverlapAnalogue.basis: Ho et al. exclude models evaluated on three or fewer benchmarks. ATB records this as a readiness diagnostic, not as proof that four instruments are sufficient.

constructs.label: Harmful operational support
constructs.higherMeans: more harmful support under the stated protocol
constructs.reason: The instruments differ in task, endpoint, judge, date, and aggregation, and currently share no model anchor.

constructs.label: Persuasion-attempt propensity
constructs.higherMeans: more attempts under the stated APE condition
constructs.reason: One ingested protocol cannot identify a cross-benchmark difficulty scale.

constructs.label: Deceptive behaviour under pressure
constructs.reason: The two cohorts use related MASK outcomes but currently share no model anchor and do not expose equivalent public item-level records.

constructs.label: Agentic influence-operation execution
constructs.reason: One helpful-only protocol cannot identify a cross-benchmark difficulty scale and is not a deployed-safeguard condition.
